articles.summary: Entocycle, the UK’s leading insect technology company, announced today a collaboration with EnviroFlight, the largest producer of insect-based ingredients for animal and plant nutrition in North America, to develop and trial the Entosight® Neo, Entocycle’s black soldier fly (BSF) breeding technology
articles.title: Entocycle and EnviroFlight partner to develop black soldier fly breeding technology

articles.summary: The rebrand is the first time since its founding in 2014 that the company has updated its logo and visual identity.
articles.title: Insect technology company Entocycle unveils new visual identity to realise global ambitions

articles.summary: Entocycle today announced raising $2.6 million to finance further expansion plans in Europe and beyond. In parallel, a new R&D insect farm developed by the insect technology company has officially opened in Yorkshire.
articles.title: Entocycle raise a further $2.6m as new insect rearing facility opens in Yorkshire

articles.summary: Entocycle, a pioneering technology company in insect farming, is proud to announce the success of its recent collaboration with EnviroFlight, the largest producer of insect-based ingredients for animal and plant nutrition in North America.
articles.title: Trials of Entocycle’s optical dosing solution at EnviroFlight a success

articles.summary: Insect technology company Entocycle and the University of Leeds, a Russell Group university, announce a partnership to advance research into the use of insects in circular on-farm feed systems.
articles.title: Entocycle and University of Leeds enter innovation partnership

articles.summary: Discover how Entocycle uses patented precision agri-tech to remove production variance and de-risk industrial-scale insect farming. Learn how our automated, biology-led solutions create investable, turnkey waste-to-value projects.
articles.title: Engineering Predictability Into Nature: How Precision Agri-Tech De-Risks Industrial Insect Farming

articles.summary: The Centre for Insect Technology, believed to be the world’s most advanced insect technology demonstration facility, is designed to develop and showcase the cutting-edge technologies crucial for scaling the insect protein industry globally.
articles.title: French former rugby union star Benjamin Kayser officially opens Entocycle’s Centre for Insect Technology

articles.summary: The new funding confirms Entocycle as a leading global player in the rapidly-growing insect industry as it looks to place its cutting-edge technology at the heart of large-scale insect farms worldwide.
articles.title: Entocycle secures $5m Series A to license tech solutions for insect farms worldwide

articles.summary: The University of Leeds and Entocycle unveil new research program dedicated to developing the protocols and codes of practice to unlock the growth of the UK insect farming industry and its potential to decarbonise livestock production.
articles.title: Leeds University and Entocycle reveal research program for commercialisation of UK insect farming

articles.summary: Bühler and Entocycle partner to deliver end-to-end technology solutions to insect farms
articles.title: Bühler and Entocycle partner to deliver end-to-end technology solutions to insect farms

articles.summary: A pioneering insect farm concept is set to scale its sustainability impact after partnering with Siemens to digitalise its operations.
articles.title: Siemens partners with Entocycle to digitalise insect farming industry
